en.headline: A complete medieval knight look: tunic, cape, hood, gauntlets and belt in one set.
en.intro: This California Costumes knight costume brings together a tunic with attached sleeves, a detachable cape with medallion, a hood, gauntlets and a belt. After you order, FeelBetter buys it from the overseas seller and ships it to you, usually within 7–14 business days with tracking sent by email.
highlights: The tunic has attached sleeves, so the base of the knight look goes on in one piece.
The cape carries a medallion and detaches, so you can wear it with or without it.
A hood and gauntlets finish the outfit from head to wrists.
A belt is included to hold the costume in place at the waist.
Two sizes, S-M and L-XL, are offered at the same price.

sections.p: The listing names five pieces: a tunic with attached sleeves, a detachable cape with medallion, a hood, gauntlets and a belt. It is a men's costume from California Costumes, model number 1370.

Choose S-M or L-XL at checkout; the listing does not include a chest or height chart. If you are between sizes, ask our concierge before ordering. It suits anyone who wants a medieval knight look for Halloween or a themed party.

cautions: Only two sizes (S-M and L-XL) are offered and no size chart is listed, so ask the concierge if you are unsure.
